testcase.name: W06 exact balances, credit availability, scoped accounts and existing Finance remain visible
W06 create form validates exact money and retains the same command across lost acknowledgement and navigation
W06 stale revision keeps draft and requires explicit reload before editing again
W06 archive requires confirmation and retains account history
W06 phone form keyboard focus, native date and custom selectors remain usable
W04 grant revocation removes a live edit form and financial details through the real SSE path
W04 a real cross-tab logout retires the session-owned financial draft
W05 record income and expense use exact balances and save-and-add only clears after success
W05 cross-currency transfer and separate fee are one confirmed intent; parent void reverses both
W06 scoped filters recover explicitly from a missing valuation rate
W05 record edit retains conflict draft and replays the same note-only write after a lost acknowledgement
W05 stale void confirmation shows inline failure without silently voiding a changed record
W04 private receipt PDF/image attach, verified download and confirmed detach keep record money
W04 an unknown receipt upload survives tab navigation and retries the same committed intent
W06 combined scoped facets, label any/all and clearing the final choice use one shared filter
W06 loaded checked rows and a cross-page captured scope remain distinct; later records stay excluded from atomic metadata bulk
W06 an unknown bulk result survives Finance navigation and explicitly replays the identical committed selection patch and nonce
W06 a stale bulk confirmation keeps the independent edit and requires a fresh preview without sending a replacement write
W06 a held privacy refresh preserves an open confirmation so Escape can release its focus and scroll ownership
W07 Admin builds three-level categories, keeps a rejected fourth-level draft and manages hidden archived history on phone in both themes
W07 linked categories expose bounded references and offer archive while unlinked labels require explicit delete confirmation
W07 lost label acknowledgement keeps the exact body and nonce across navigation and explicitly retries without a duplicate
W07 Member reads catalog and labels without management controls or mutation permission
W07 clone opens a fresh draft without a write and explicit Save creates a distinct manual record with the same exact money
W07 revoking source access retires an open clone draft through the real SSE path before any Save
W07 split validates exact totals and preserves one posting, balance and source; category filters select split children only once
W07 an unknown split survives navigation and retries the exact confirmed rows and nonce without a second revision
W07 a split clone edits amount and allocations in its new draft and creates one independent posting only on Save
W07 templates save personal configuration without a ledger write, then apply default labels and exact splits to a reviewed new draft
W07 an unknown template save retries the original metadata intent across navigation without creating a financial record or duplicate template
W07 template archive is confirmed and reversible while another Admin cannot read personal template contents
W08 report UI uses exact shared filters, unique label totals and navigates its drilldown back to records
W08 balance ignores note and category selection while missing FX remains explicit and private accounts stay absent
W08 Admin public rate refresh retains the original date and nonce after a lost acknowledgement and navigation
W09 personal dashboard uses real scoped data, keyboard layout controls persist, phone layout fits and global dashboard drilldown opens the exact list
W09 saved personal filters and charts reload the exact scope and chosen chart style without writing any financial record
